messages.subject: shiny and dplyr compatibility
parts:
Hi all. I don't know whether to post this in the dplyr or the shiny google group *shrug*.

versions:
shiny-0.8.0.99
shinyIncubator-0.2.0
dplyr-0.1

I am trying to start making use of dplyr from within shiny. I am connecting to a local mysql db using src_mysql(), and have no issues here... everything seems to work as it should. For example, I have a tbl in the mysql db called 'saved_values' (with a "Nutr_No" column) and the following dplyr code works as I figure it should:

filter(saved_values, Nutr_No == 203)

... output is returned as expected, but when I replace the '203' with a reactive input:

# input$Nutr_No is a selectInput(), which returns a number (one of which is '203')
filter(saved_values, Nutr_No == input$Nutr_No)

... but this returns the following error:

no applicable method for 'escape' applied to an object of class "reactivevalues"

I think it has something to do with the ?class/type? of input$Nutr_No, which I figure can be coerced into a workable type, but I've tried as.character()/as.numeric()/etc. and can't figure how to get it to work.

Again, this is likely some combination of how dplyr::filter is interacting with the reactive inputs from shiny.

Thank you!
